🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF: Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive, a narrow/weak backdrop. VXX (1W: +45.81% | 1M: +47.78%) is ABOVE TREND and SPY/TLT is falling (1W: -9.15% | 1M: -9.73%; BELOW TREND), with HYG/LQD also falling (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -0.65%; BELOW TREND).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is increasing: VXX (1W: +45.81% | 1M: +47.78%) is ABOVE TREND. Credit stress is rising as HYG/LQD falls (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -0.65%; BELOW TREND); SPY/TLT is also falling (1W: -9.15% | 1M: -9.73%; BELOW TREND).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Tighter conditions: UUP (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +2.49%) is ABOVE TREND, indicating a firmer dollar. The yield-curve indicator is rising (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +0.11%; ABOVE TREND), while TLT (1W: +2.61% | 1M: +0.06%) is ABOVE TREND.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Sector breadth is uniformly negative: 0/11 sectors positive. XLK (1W: -12.49% | 1M: -18.28%) is BELOW TREND; XLE (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -10.45%) is also BELOW TREND, while the XLY/XLP ratio is rising (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +0.58%; ABOVE TREND); style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are BELOW TREND: SPY (1W: -8.56% | 1M: -9.71%). EEM (1W: -11.62% | 1M: -12.77%) is BELOW TREND, and FXI (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -3.76%) is BELOW TREND; relative indicators show Europe vs US rising (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +5.52%; ABOVE TREND) and India vs EM rising (1W: +12.22% | 1M: +31.14%; ABOVE TREND).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative appetite is weak: ARKK (1W: -14.36% | 1M: -21.55%) is BELOW TREND, and IBIT (1W: -15.20% | 1M: -28.31%) is BELOW TREND. Small caps are also under pressure: IWM (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -7.25%) is BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity weakness: CPER (1W: -9.88% | 1M: -14.43%) and GLD (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -12.50%) are both BELOW TREND. Agriculture is showing relative strength versus the market, with its ratio rising (1W: +6.29% | 1M: +3.37%; ABOVE TREND).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy remains weak: XLE (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -10.45%) is BELOW TREND, while BNO (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -14.35%) is BELOW TREND. Natural gas is firmer: UNG (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +6.77%) is ABOVE TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Broad downside is confirmed by SPY (1W: -8.56% | 1M: -9.71%), XLK (1W: -12.49% | 1M: -18.28%), and IWM (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -7.25%), all BELOW TREND; TLT (1W: +2.61% | 1M: +0.06%) is ABOVE TREND. Divergence is limited among these core ETFs; XLP (1W: -2.05% | 1M: +0.52%) is in CORRECTION and LQD (1W: +0.86% | 1M: -0.18%) is in RECOVERY.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor a defensive posture while breadth remains 0/11, and reduce exposure to high-beta areas such as XLK (1W: -12.49% | 1M: -18.28%) and ARKK (1W: -14.36% | 1M: -21.55%), both BELOW TREND. TLT (1W: +2.61% | 1M: +0.06%) is ABOVE TREND; style mixed / no clear leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth improves and cyclicals stabilize, monitor XLE (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -10.45%), currently BELOW TREND. BEARISH: If weakness persists, reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -12.49% | 1M: -18.28%), also BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If momentum holds, monitor UNG (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +6.77%), ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: If broad commodity weakness continues, watch CPER (1W: -9.88% | 1M: -14.43%), BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor HYG/LQD at 0.7361, falling (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -0.65%; BELOW TREND), and XLK/XLF at 2.7306, falling (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -16.69%; BELOW TREND). VXX (1W: +45.81% | 1M: +47.78%) is ABOVE TREND; monitor whether the volatility surge persists.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive and broad, weak participation. Relative resilience is concentrated in bonds, with TLT (1W: +2.61% | 1M: +0.06%) ABOVE TREND; sector leadership remains mixed. Monitor rising fear in VXX (1W: +45.81% | 1M: +47.78%) and falling credit ratio HYG/LQD (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -0.65%), both reinforcing downside risk.
